podcast.title: Preserving Father's Memory
podcast.body: Alongside her younger sister Toni, Lillian actively performs her father's songs online and live to honor his memory. "Both of them have been keeping their fathers' memory alive by performing a songs both online and live."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Singing Talent
podcast.body: Lillian Cornell is noted as being "quite the singer." "Her older sister, Lillian, is also quite the singer."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
